title: Date Field
description: A date typed one segment at a time, in the order and format of the user's locale; joins a Field around it.

components.DateField: Lets the user type a date one segment at a time, in the order and format of their locale. Inside a DatePicker or DateRangePicker it takes the picker's dates and settings.
components.DateFieldInput: One segment of the date, such as the day or the month, or a separator between two.
